## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, Developer Certificate of Origin, https://developercertificate.org)
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (or, for `edge-setup/` only, `make -C edge-setup check`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] A line in `CHANGELOG.md` under `## Non publié` (or `edge-setup/CHANGELOG.md`, `protocol/CHANGELOG.md`) for a user- or developer-visible change
- [ ] Screenshots or a short recording for a UI change (light and dark, desktop and narrow width when relevant)
- [ ] No secret, token, ticket or real personal data in code, tests, fixtures, logs or screenshots
- [ ] Wire protocol unchanged, or `protocol/SPEC.md`, the test vectors and both implementations updated together
